preconditions.description: The input must be a non-empty string containing at least one vowel ('a', 'e', 'i', 'o', 'u').

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'aeiou' for c in vowels) and len(vowels) > 0
postconditions.description: The set `vowels` contains only lowercase letters from the patriotic group 'aeiou' and is non-empty.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(vowel_group, tuple) and len(vowel_group) == 2 for vowel_group in vowel_groups)
postconditions.description: The list `vowel_groups` contains tuples where each tuple represents a vowel group as (vowel_char, count_of_repeats).

postconditions.expression: sum(count_of_repeats - 1 for (vowel_char, count_of_repeats) in vowel_groups) == extra_vowels
postconditions.description: The variable `extra_vowels` is the sum of all extra consecutive vowels (count_of_repeats - 1) across all vowel groups.
The variable `num_vowel_groups` is the number of distinct vowel groups (each group is a sequence of the same vowel repeated consecutively).
The function returns the rounded (to two decimal places) value of `extra_vowels` divided by `num_vowel_groups`.
